alternatives: Single decisions.jsonl with a conflict-tolerant reader (repairs damage but still shows conflicted PRs on forges); markdown ADRs in docs/adr as source of truth (loses graph anchoring; sequential numbering collides across branches); decisions as derived graph nodes only (lost on rebuild).
consequences: Appending decisions on parallel branches never conflicts. Same-day same-slug collisions across branches surface as two files (ordinal suffix within one checkout); doctor flags duplicate ids. The decision log is a budget (~100 active records) - significance filtering lives in the skill, not the tool.
context: Decision records must be committed (nothing can regenerate rationale) yet merge-safe: a single decisions.jsonl would recreate the derived-graph failure - forges compute mergeability in a bare repo where gitattributes union merge is never consulted, so parallel branches appending records would conflict on every PR. Ids embedding repo_id would break on forks and no-remote clones, where repo_id computes differently unless meta.json is committed.
decided_by: marcus (ratified in session, recorded by claude)
decision: Each decision is one canonical JSON file at .reposkein/decisions/<date>-<slug>.json with a portable adr:<date>-<slug> id. Bodies are immutable (body_hash-checked); only status, supersession, and anchor re-stamping may change; records are never machine-deleted. Anchors keep full rs1: node ids but match tolerantly by suffix across repo_id drift, with content-hash recovery for renamed nodes.
title: Architecture decisions stored file-per-decision with portable ids
